acceptance_criteria: Schema evidence collected without assuming Servidores_Conexiones.name

queries.name: runtime_database_identity
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name, @@SERVERNAME AS server_name

queries.name: servidores_api_candidate_tables
queries.sql: SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Servidor%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Conexion%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Conexiones%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%API%' ORDER BY TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME

queries.name: servidores_api_candidate_columns
queries.sql: SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE, ORDINAL_POSITION FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Servidor%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Conexion%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Conexiones%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%API%' ORDER BY TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, ORDINAL_POSITION

queries.name: rbac_candidate_columns
queries.sql: SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE, ORDINAL_POSITION FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Permis%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Rol%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Usuario%' OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Permis%' OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Rol%' OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Usuario%' ORDER BY TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, ORDINAL_POSITION

queries.name: empresa_scope_candidate_columns
queries.sql: SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE, ORDINAL_POSITION FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Empresa%' OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Empresa%' OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%UsuarioID%' OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Usuario%' ORDER BY TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, ORDINAL_POSITION

objective: Discover EDARSAHUB SQL schema for Servidores API connections and RBAC Empresa scope without assuming business column names. Schema-only recovery after R1C failed on invalid column name.
